title: Retrieving Complementary Evidence for Multi-Hop RAG with Semantic Gain Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.15285v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires finding documents whose evidence is useful in combination. Query relevance and graph connectivity help locate related content, but neither directly measures the additional information one document contributes given another. We introduce SG$^2$RAG, a framework that represents this complementarity through semantic gain. Offline, a large language model assesses the relevant and nonredundant information contributed by one chunk given another within neighborhoods proposed by semantic similarity. These ordered assessments are aggregated into symmetric edge weights to construct a reusable Semantic Gain Graph. Online, controlled Personalized PageRank starts from query-relevant seeds and ranks complementary evidence beyond the initial retrieval set. Experiments on MuSiQue, 2Wiki, and HotpotQA with two language model backbones show that SG$^2$RAG achieves the best average EM, F1, and Reca

translated_title: 基于语义增益图的多跳RAG互补证据检索
translated_abstract: 多跳检索增强生成（RAG）需要找到那些证据组合起来有用的文档。查询相关性和图连通性有助于定位相关内容，但两者都无法直接衡量在给定另一个文档的情况下，一个文档所贡献的额外信息。我们提出了SG$^2$RAG，一个通过语义增益来刻画这种互补性的框架。在离线阶段，大语言模型在语义相似性所提出的邻域内，评估一个文本块在给定另一个文本块时所贡献的相关且非冗余的信息。这些有序的评估结果被聚合为对称的边权重，从而构建出一个可复用的语义增益图。在在线阶段，受控的个性化PageRank从与查询相关的种子节点出发，对超出初始检索集之外的互补证据进行排序。在MuSiQue、2Wiki和HotpotQA数据集上使用两种语言模型骨干网络的实验表明，SG$^2$RAG在平均EM、F1和召回率上取得了最佳表现。
tldr: 提出SG$^2$RAG框架，利用大语言模型离线评估文本块之间的非冗余语义增益并构建可复用的语义增益图，再通过个性化PageRank在线检索多跳RAG所需的互补证据，在多个基准数据集上取得最优性能。
en_tdlr: SG$^2$RAG constructs a reusable Semantic Gain Graph by using an LLM to assess non-redundant information between text chunks offline, then applies Personalized PageRank online to retrieve complementary evidence for multi-hop RAG, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks.
